answer: A container with the `unless-stopped` restart policy starts again after a daemon restart because this policy tells Docker to restart the container irrespective of its exit code, but it stops if the container is manually stopped. Since you only manually stopped the container without stopping the Docker daemon, when the daemon restarts, the container will start again according to the `unless-stopped` policy.
